top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new chemical principle, event-driven catalytic induced proximity, confirmed by many independent groups and ternary-complex structures. Crews and Deshaies are the founders of the designed PROTAC concept, and Handa's identification of cereblon is a separate mechanistic discovery that explains thalidomide-class drugs and made glue degraders rational. P001 describes the modality as it exists, covering both routes, whereas P002 would leave out the cereblon strand. P002 is a defensible and historically cleaner second choice, and any B029 prize is preferable to no award despite the missing approved drug and the crowded attribution.
